name: @orbital/relay
description: The blind relay between a Mac running Orbital and its paired phones.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --outfile=dist/index.mjs --external:better-sqlite3 --external:pg --banner:js="import { createRequire as __relayCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __relayCreateRequire(import.meta.url);"
